content_feed.headline: Juniper Green Energy Commissions ~42 MWp Solar Component of Wind Solar Hybrid Project
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Material capacity commissioning of renewable energy project.
content_feed.telegram_post: 🏭 #COMMERCIAL_PRODUCTION | Juniper Green Energy Limited (NSE: JNPR) Juniper Green Energy Commissions ~42 MWp Solar Component of Wind Solar Hybrid Project ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Commissioned Capacity: ~42 MWp solar component - Project Scope: 120 MW Wind Solar Hybrid Power Project - Current Project Capacity: ~124 MWp out of 152 MWp total planned capacity - Total Aggregate Operational Capacity: ~2,994 MWp and ~698 MWh BESS 📌 What happened: ↳ Juniper Green Spark Four Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Juniper Green Energy Limited, commissioned a ~42 MWp solar component at its Wind Solar Hybrid Power Project site, taking total operational capacity of the company and its subsidiaries to ~2,994 MWp. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Tata Steel Approves Tubes Business Transfer and Divestment of Tata Steel Colors for ₹28,000 Crore
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Material business transfer and divestment of subsidiary stake for a substantial combined consideration.
content_feed.telegram_post: 🤝 #ACQUISITION | Tata Steel Limited (NSE: TATASTEEL) Tata Steel Approves Tubes Business Transfer and Divestment of Tata Steel Colors for ₹28,000 Crore ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Counterparty: APL Apollo Tubes Limited - Tubes Business Consideration: Up to ₹11,700 crore - Tata Steel Colors Stake Divestment: ₹16,300 crore for 100% equity stake - Transaction Route: Slump sale and Share Purchase Agreement 📌 What happened: ↳ Tata Steel's Board approved transferring its tubes business at Jamshedpur, Hosur, Khopoli, and Sahibabad along with cold rolling and surface coated steel product facilities at Khopoli to APL Apollo for up to ₹11,700 crore. Additionally, the company approved the sale of its 100% equity stake in subsidiary Tata Steel Colors Private Limited to APL Apollo for ₹16,300 crore. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
